paragraphs: The Discovery D250 is part of the fifth-generation Discovery range (L462, 2017–present), using the Ingenium AJ200D 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel. The D250 sits in the middle of the diesel lineup, offering a balance of power and efficiency. Like other JLR Ingenium diesel models, it uses the same engine family as the D300 and D350 but with a lower output tune. Land Rover Discovery D250 Engine Compatibility Because the Discovery D250 uses a specific tune of the Ingenium AJ200D diesel, getting the right matching is essential. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Discovery D250 owners, yes. about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200D (Ingenium) engines for every Discovery D250 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Discovery D250 from 2023 to present. The AJ200D (Ingenium) features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ200D (Ingenium) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D (Ingenium) rebuild.
